title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B outpaint, DA settings
description: Grow a picture with FLUX.2 Klein 9B. Pad fits the picture inside a target size and centers it (set Target width and Target height; the sample goes from 768x768 to 1152x768), or, with both targets at 0, adds the pixels you give it on the left, top, right and bottom. The new area starts as the picture's edges stretched outward and blurred (Fill edge-blur; Blur sets how soft), and its mask fades into the original near the seam (Feathering), which the Sampler follows with Soft mask on, so the seam blends. The original, un-padded, is also the model's reference, so the new part matches it. Denoise 1.0, seed 776, 6 steps, euler, flow shift 2.02. The DA workflow pads with gray at denoise 0.8 to 0.9; with Klein 9B at 6 steps that left the bands flat on many seeds (in ComfyUI too), so this template differs on purpose (measured 2026-11-24: both test seeds fill, and the kept area changes about half as much as with gray). Growing beyond 1.5x the original size can lose consistency, and a follow-up inpaint near denoise 0.6 often helps. Describe the whole picture in the prompt, not only the new part.
